commits.messageBody:
Mirror server-fork cc361630. Use MXCSR for x64 rounding and exception masks, preserving sticky status and DAZ/FTZ. Make selectable precision explicitly unavailable on x64 and keep the collision precision bracket x86-only.

Win32 behavior, including the legacy precision-setter bug, is preserved. The integration DPVS C2 candidate remains tied to the observed legacy PC64 path; fixing that setter is separate work.

Actual v120 Debug/Release TUs pass 46/46 Win32 and 67/67 x64 control/rounding checks per configuration; stock Win32 also passes and x64 no-op controls fail 21 checks. Real dependency libraries are linked. This does not establish physics equivalence, exception trap delivery or native Direct3D state.

(cherry picked from commit 1c90143692936b20721a452fdb72819d018adef3)
commits.messageHeadline: foundation: define native SSE floating-point controls on x64
